name: IMSA Predictions
summary: Multi-class forecasts for the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.
description: Scaffolded on the shared MotorsportVerse core with working seams: a snapshot-backed DataSource implementing the core calendar/grid/results contract, a leakage-guarded prior-form Predictor, and a contract test suite asserting that nothing is fabricated while no feed is wired. Multi-class like WEC, with a second points structure over the endurance rounds and materially changing entry lists. See the project README.
